# OpenAI Python SDK Releases

## Latest Releases (May 2026 - March 2026)

**v2.37.0** (May 15, 2026)
- Added `service_tier` parameter to responses compact method
- Supported eagerly validating pydantic iterators
- Removed unnecessary `client_id` for workload identity provider authentication
- Fixed missing f-string prefix in file type error message

**v2.36.0** (May 7, 2026)
- Manual API updates
- Realtime 2 API implementation

**v2.35.1** (May 6, 2026)
- Fixed imagegen `size` enum regression

**v2.35.0** (May 6, 2026)
- Updated image generation API
- Removed legacy Python CLI
- Updated `top_logprobs` parameter documentation

**v2.34.0** (May 4, 2026)
- Added `external_key_id` to projects and email/metadata params to users
- Implemented Admin API Keys per endpoint support
- Added header configuration via environment variables
- Multiple authentication and type fixes

**v2.33.0** (April 28, 2026)
- API updates
- Fixed `prompt_cache_retention` enum value

**v2.32.0** (April 15, 2026)
- Added detail field to InputFileContent
- Implemented websocket event handlers and reconnection support
- Enhanced file parameter handling

**v2.31.0** (April 8, 2026)
- Added phase field to conversations message
- Implemented short-lived tokens support
- Added raw data transmission over websockets

**v2.30.0** (March 25, 2026)
- Added keys field to computer actions (Click, Drag, etc.)
- Aligned response types with expanded schemas

**v2.29.0** (March 17, 2026)
- Added GPT-5.4 nano and mini model support
- Added `/v1/videos` endpoint to batches
- Implemented comparison filter operators (in, nin)
